First, 03-05-1103 means 1103-05-03 (YYYY-MM-DD).  
31 weeks = 31 × 7 = 217 days.  
Add 2 more days → total 219 days.  

1103 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, and not divisible by 100? Actually 1103 not divisible by 4, so not leap).  
From 1103-05-03:  
May has 31 days → add 28 days to 1103-05-31 → 1103-05-31.  
Remaining days: 219 - 28 = 191 days.  

June 1103: 30 days → 191 - 30 = 161 left, date now 1103-07-01 (after June).  
July: 31 → 161 - 31 = 130, date 1103-08-01.  
August: 31 → 130 - 31 = 99, date 1103-09-01.  
September: 30 → 99 - 30 = 69, date 1103-10-01.  
October: 31 → 69 - 31 = 38, date 1103-11-01.  
November: 30 → 38 - 30 = 8, date 1103-12-01.  
December: 31 → 8 days into December → 1103-12-09.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1103-12-09
